config.name: Champion League Season 1
config.notes: Every preset army. League phase (league.cjs): four pots of twelve, eight battles each - two from every pot, one as Player A and one as Player B - over eight matchdays; no rematches, no two armies of one faction. Then a seeded best-of-3 knockout: 1st-8th to the round of 16, 9th-24th in the play-off. Vanilla: no doctrine. Each Day is looked at, and bugs or AI issues fixed, before the next.
